selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
你的治疗之潮图腾、治疗之泉图腾或灵魂链接图腾在召唤时会施放一次无消耗且瞬发的治疗链，产生100%的效果。

 增强
熔岩猛击有几率召唤一个灼热图腾，对附近的一名敌人造成([65.205% of Spell Power])点火焰伤害，持续8秒。

熔岩猛击和流电炽焰使你的灼热图腾向周围最多5名敌人施放一次灼烧齐射，造成([92.736% of Spell Power])点火焰伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Lava Lash has a chance to summon a Searing Totem to hurl Searing Bolts that deal (65.205% of Spell Power) Fire damage to a nearby enemy. Lasts 8 sec.

Lava Lash and Voltaic Blaze cause your Searing Totems to shoot a Searing Volley at up to 5 nearby enemies for (92.736% of Spell Power) Fire damage.

 Restoration
When you summon a Healing Tide Totem, Healing Stream Totem, or Spirit Link Totem you cast a free instant Chain Heal at 100% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
治疗链弹射到最后一个目标后会跃向20码内的一个图腾，使图腾对30码内的一名受伤的盟友施放治疗链，恢复([220.5% of Spell Power])点生命值。可跳转到20码内的2名目标。

 增强
闪电箭、闪电链和元素冲击有几率向你的涌动图腾射出一支涌动飞箭，使图腾的伤害提高10%，随后跃向你的目标，造成([161% of Attack Power])点自然伤害。伤害加成效果可以叠加。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
Chain Heal now jumps to a nearby totem within 20 yards once it reaches its last target, causing the totem to cast Chain Heal on an injured ally within 30 yards for (220.5% of Spell Power). Jumps to 2 nearby targets within 20 yards.

 Enhancement
Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Elemental Blast has a chance to unleash a Surging Bolt at your Surging Totem, increasing the totem's damage by 10%, and then redirecting the bolt to your target for (161% of Attack Power) Nature damage. The damage bonus effect can stack.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 有图腾激活时，图腾每30秒使你获得一个护盾，吸收([Total Health] * 6 / 100)点伤害，持续30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing (Total Health * 6 / 100) damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将萨满图腾工艺发挥至极致，召唤充能浪涌图腾为周围提供持续的元素灌注与冲击波。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Elevates totemic mastery to legendary heights, deploying Surging Totems that emanate continuous elemental pulses.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
受到你的大地生命效果影响的盟友，从你这里获得的治疗效果提高15%。

 增强
在涌动图腾周围40码内施放裂地术会使其在目标区域引发一次效果为125%的震颤。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
Allies affected by your Earthliving effect receive 15% increased healing from you.

 Enhancement
Casting Sundering within 40 yards of your Surging Totem causes it to create a Tremor at 125% effectiveness at the target area.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
习得一种新的武器灌魔：唤潮者的护卫
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Increases the critical strike chance of Flametongue Weapon by 25%, and its critical strike damage by 100%.

 Restoration
Learn a new weapon imbue, Tidecaller's Guard.

subSpellsCn.name: 唤潮者的护卫
subSpellsCn.description: 为你的盾牌注入水元素之力，持续1小时。你造成的治疗效果提高2.0%，你的治疗之泉图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

subSpellsEn.name: Tidecaller's Guard
subSpellsEn.description: Imbue your shield with the element of Water for 1 hour. Your healing done is increased by 2.0% and the duration of your Healing Stream Totem is increased by 3.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 治疗之雨的治疗效果提高10%，施法时间缩短0.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the healing done by Healing Rain by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受到你的治疗波、治疗链或激流的初始治疗而恢复生命值的目标，其生命值提高5%，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Targets you heal with Healing Wave, Chain Heal, or Riptide's initial heal gain 5% increased health for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 大地之盾使目标受到的伤害降低3%，并根据目标损失的生命值，其治疗效果最多提高150%。生命值低于50%时达到最大效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Earth Shield reduces damage taken by 3% and its healing is increased by up to 150% as its target's health decreases. Maximum benefit is reached below 50% health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激流的初始治疗量提高20%，爆击几率提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Riptide's initial heal is increased 20% and has a 10% increased critical strike chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
在你的脚下召唤一个图腾，持续10秒。该图腾每2秒作用一次，为40码范围内的所有小队或团队成员恢复([514.5% of Spell Power])点生命值。

目标超过5个时治疗量降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Summons a totem at your feet for 10 sec, which pulses every 2 sec, healing all party or raid members within 40 yards for (514.5% of Spell Power).

Healing reduced beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激流的冷却时间缩短1.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Riptide by 1.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
增强
施放涌动图腾后，你的下一次熔岩猛击会以150%的效果再次施放。

 恢复
治疗之泉图腾和治疗之潮图腾的治疗效果有8%的几率对受到治疗的盟友施加大地生命。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
After casting Surging Totem, your next Lava Lash casts again at 150% effectiveness.

 Restoration
Healing Stream Totem and Healing Tide Totem healing has a 8% chance to apply Earthliving to allies it heals.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精通提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Mastery increased by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
治疗之泉图腾的冷却时间缩短3秒。

 增强
熔岩猛击的伤害提高10%。

每消耗一层漩涡武器，使正在生效的灼热之手的持续时间延长0.20秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Lava Lash damage increased by 10%.

Each stack of Maelstrom Weapon consumed increases the duration of an active Hot Hand by 0.20 sec.

 Restoration
Reduces the cooldown of Healing Stream Totem by 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 施放 [先祖迅捷: 先祖 / 自然]迅捷使你能够施放一次风暴涌流图腾，且风暴涌流图腾不再消耗一层治疗之泉图腾充能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Casting [Ancestral Swiftness: Ancestral / Nature's] Swiftness grants a use of Stormstream Totem and Stormstream Totem no longer consumes a charge of Healing Stream Totem when used.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 治疗之泉和风暴涌流图腾的治疗效果提高30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Healing Stream and Stormstream Totem healing increased by 30%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 激流有6%的几率将你的下一个治疗之泉图腾升级为风暴涌流图腾，使其治疗量提高10%，额外治疗1名盟友，效果为100%，并在使用时为2名受伤的盟友恢复([1323% of Spell Power])点生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Riptide has a 6% chance to upgrade your next Healing Stream Totem to Stormstream Totem which heals for 10% more, heals 1 additional ally at 100% effectiveness, and heals 2 injured allies for (1323% of Spell Power) healing when used.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 治疗之泉图腾会将你已激活的激流的持续时间延长3.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Healing Stream Totem extends the duration of your active Riptides by 3.0 sec.
